items.title_en: Metro vs AQI 30: Couple who lived in Delhi and Bengaluru compare cities
items.title_zh: 地铁与 AQI 30：居住在德里和班加罗尔的夫妇比较城市
items.summary_en: Rather than choosing one city over the other, Vancha and Saksham spoke about the experiences they have come to appreciate in each.
items.summary_zh: 万查和萨克沙姆没有选择一个城市而不是另一个城市，而是谈到了他们在每个城市所欣赏的经历。

items.title_en: ‘Better off in India’: Man says high expenses in Dubai make it hard to save
items.title_zh: “在印度过得更好”：男子表示迪拜的高额消费让人难以储蓄
items.summary_en: In an Instagram video shared a day ago, Rahul Bala spoke about the challenges of living in Dubai and warned people to ‘think twice’ before moving there for work.
items.summary_zh: 在一天前分享的 Instagram 视频中，拉胡尔·巴拉 (Rahul Bala) 谈到了在迪拜生活的挑战，并警告人们在搬到迪拜工作之前要“三思而后行”。

items.title_zh: 2026年世界数学最好的国家：七个亚洲国家跻身前十

items.title_en: An Architecture History Professor In Ireland Just Found The Shell Of A Medieval Castle Hiding Inside A Victorian University Building
items.title_zh: 爱尔兰的一位建筑史教授刚刚在维多利亚大学大楼内发现了一座中世纪城堡的外壳
items.summary_en: University College Dublin Architecture experts identified the medieval remnants and walls of Roebuck Castle beneath the plaster of the present-day building. New research has shown that the remains of a medieval castle, long believed to be lost to history, have actually been hiding inside an active building on an Irish university’s campus.
